name: Inspora · Inspora

title.zh: Inspora · 适合按类别浏览近期视觉与创意

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Inspora 是一个按 Web、Branding、Product、Motion、Illustration、3D、Print 分类的视觉设计作品档案库，首页列出最新与精选条目，并称每小时更新。单条作品页会标注作者、行业、颜色与风格，例如 Discord and Liveblocks UI cards 被标为 Motion、SaaS、Animated，并提供 View original 外链。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Inspora (https://www.inspora.design/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
